name: Far Cry
description: Play the island campaign together. FarCryCoop lets one player host and friends join the same Far Cry (2004) campaign: every player is on the island, in the same map, with the enemies, vehicles and weapons shared.

setup.title: Far Cry
setup.detail: Install Far Cry from your Steam library.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it in the game's folder.

hostSteps: Download the mod above. Cairn puts it in the game's folder and keeps it up to date.
Press Play: the game starts with the co-op mod. Open the console with the ~ key and type #CoopMap("pier") (or another map).
Friends need your IP and UDP port 49001 open on your router, or a virtual network you share (Radmin VPN, ZeroTier).
joinSteps: Download the mod above, the same version as the host's, then press Play.
Choose Multiplayer then LAN: the host's game shows up. Or open the console (~) and type connect followed by the host's IP.
Wait for the map to load: you arrive on the host's island.

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: One player hosts a campaign map and friends join by address. Everyone needs the same version of the mod and Far Cry 1.4.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod in the game's folder and updates it when a new version is released.

items.name: Shared island
items.detail: Players share the map, the enemies, the weapons and the vehicles.

items.name: Known limits
items.detail: Cutscenes are off for joined players, helicopters fly only for the host, and joined players cannot push barrels and crates.
